Forecast models include MECCA baseline, Intuitive, RandomForest and Hybrid. Key metrics: MAPE, MAE, sales per labour hour, total wages, event vs non-event performance, and weekend vs weekday trading patterns. Rostering views focus on hours per week and 12-week wages.
